tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Enterprise Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java & Spring APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Ecommerce Enterprise Architect
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining Talent Revelation Group to support complex enterprise e-commerce initiatives. With over 5 years of professional experience building and integrating large-scale platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in enterprise Java, backend architecture, and seamless system integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise Platform Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality and data flows on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java, Spring, and design patterns, ensuring high availability and scalability for global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: API Design & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, while engineering API migrations and data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms to maintain cross-system consistency.

bullets.label: System Modernization & Performance
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring, optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee and DataHub, and resolved complex integration bottlenecks across enterprise ecosystems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Acted as a bridge between business and IT stakeholders to translate complex enterprise requirements into scalable architectural solutions and coordinate international delivery.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit requiring no sponsorship, and am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise e-commerce experience aligns with your goals.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell to Talent Revelation Group, contributing deep expertise in scalable Java architectures, complex integrations, and high-performance platform delivery for global business environments.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture, API integration, and backend development experience to Talent Revelation Group.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am a Senior E-Commerce Developer with 5+ years building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am interested in your architect roles, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on Dec 16, 2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Ecommerce Enterprise Architect - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Ecommerce Enterprise Architect position at Talent Revelation Group. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience building scalable backend architectures, APIs, and data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to your team.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid work permit, and am available to start on 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
